CertainTeed Presidential TL Roof Installation in Milpitas, CA
ROOF EXPRESS recently completed a premium roof replacement in Milpitas featuring CertainTeed Presidential TL shingles. This luxury roofing system is designed to replicate the appearance of hand-split cedar shake while delivering the long-term durability and low maintenance of modern asphalt shingles.
Luxury Roofing Upgrade for a Milpitas Home
For this project, our team removed the existing roofing materials and performed a thorough inspection of the roof deck. After replacing any damaged plywood, we installed a complete roofing system that included high-performance synthetic underlayment, ice and water shield at vulnerable areas, new flashings, and the CertainTeed Presidential TL shingles.

The homeowner selected Presidential TL because of its rich texture, heavyweight construction, and exceptional curb appeal. The finished roof dramatically enhanced the home’s appearance while providing superior protection against wind, rain, and UV exposure.
Why CertainTeed Presidential TL Is a Top-Tier Roofing System
CertainTeed Presidential TL is one of the most prestigious asphalt shingle products available. Its triple-layer design creates deep shadow lines and a dimensional look that closely resembles natural cedar shake. In addition to its premium appearance, this roofing system offers excellent weather resistance and robust manufacturer warranty coverage.

Milpitas homeowners often choose Presidential TL when they want a roof that combines luxury aesthetics with long-lasting performance.
Expert Installation Matters
Luxury shingles require precise installation to perform as intended. Our experienced roofing crew followed all manufacturer specifications to ensure proper alignment, fastening, and ventilation. The result is a roof that not only looks outstanding but is built to protect the home for decades.
ROOF EXPRESS – Milpitas Roofing Specialists
ROOF EXPRESS is a Diamond Certified and GAF Certified roofing contractor serving Milpitas and the entire Bay Area. We specialize in high-end roofing systems, including CertainTeed Presidential TL, architectural asphalt shingles, and custom roofing solutions.

If you are considering a premium roof replacement in Milpitas, contact ROOF EXPRESS for a free estimate. We deliver exceptional workmanship, top-quality materials, and dependable service on every project.

Call ROOF EXPRESS today at 650-666-5554 or visit ROOF EXPRESS to schedule your free roof inspection.
